title: Trap and Spring
format: 5v5 plus two keepers, Blue press Red from the goal kick
area: 50m x 36m, a goal at each end (7m wide), halfway line marked with cones
kit: Red and Blue bibs, keepers in a third colour, plenty of balls in each goal
start: Red keeper starts with the ball and plays out to a centre back

steps.say: Red keeper plays out. Blue hold a trap: B1 stands between the two centre backs.
steps.vo: Red start with the keeper. Blue set a trap. B1 stands between the two centre backs, and B2 and B3 sit wide and a little back.

steps.say: B1 curves the run and shuts the pass inside. The only option is out to the full back.
steps.vo: The centre back has the ball. B1 curves his run so the pass inside is shut off. The only safe pass is out to the full back.

steps.say: TRIGGER: the ball goes wide and slow. B2 springs, B4 slides across.
steps.vo: That is the trigger. The ball goes wide and slow, so B2 springs. B4 slides across behind him, and B3 tucks in to cover the middle.

steps.say: Everyone else takes a pass away. R3 is trapped against the line.
steps.vo: Everybody takes a pass away. B1 blocks the pass back inside. B3 marks the next player. R3 is trapped against the touchline with nowhere to go.

steps.say: B2 wins it. First pass is forward to B4 who is already in the middle.
steps.vo: B2 wins the ball high up the pitch. His first pass goes forward into B4, who was already waiting in the middle.

steps.say: B4 slides it to B1 who has run beyond the centre backs. B1 shoots.
steps.vo: B4 slides the ball into the path of B1, who has run beyond the centre backs. B1 shoots first time.

setup: Blue 4 pressers (B1 to B4) plus B5 as a spare, against Red 5 (R1 to R5) and a Red keeper (KL).
Blue start in a 1 2 1 shape in Red's half. Red start with the keeper on the ball.
A second Blue keeper (KR) defends the right hand goal.
rules: Blue score only after winning the ball in the Red half. A goal counts double.
Red score by playing through the Blue press and getting a shot at the right hand goal.
If Red play long, Blue get a point for the first header or second ball won.
Rotate who presses first every two minutes.
restart: Ball out of play: Red keeper restarts.
Blue shoot: the Red keeper restarts straight away, so Blue must reset the trap.
points: Curve the run: show the ball carrier one way and shut the pass behind you.
Wait for the trigger: a slow pass, a bad touch or a back pass to the side.
Spring as one: when the first player goes, everyone moves with him.
Win it high, then go forward at once.
progress: Add a Red spare player so it is 5v6 and the press must be sharper.
Count the seconds from regain to shot. Aim for under six.
Play 9v9 and award a point for every regain in the final third.
